notes.title: Thank You For Playing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32271869/66a4759dfef9ddec19ecd70df4122ceb647cda65.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone - taking a brief moment from all of the launch day chaos and excitement to pop in and say 'Thanks' - seriously, it's been one hell of a ride up til this point and it's nice to take a step back and just take it all in you know?

Right at the finish line as LKA wrapped up development on Martha Is Dead, we asked the dev team to record their thoughts on the journey as a whole for a special episode of Martha Uncovered, you can catch the episode below, as well as some personal words from Luca to you, the fans :

[previewyoutube=UQNT_DDzlvM;full][/previewyoutube] 

"Hello everyone,

I am Luca Dalcò, LKA's art director and writer.
I'm here to talk about Martha is Dead, our new game that will be released today!
Today…needless to say, I, and the whole team, are very excited and nervous!
The moment of release is a special one.
Years of work and passion become something real.
All the passion, all the emotions, all the love we put into the game becomes a public thing and we feel naked, it's inevitable!

It is very difficult for me to describe Martha is Dead in a few words:
It is a psychological horror/thriller that follows the dramatic story of a girl who suffers a great trauma in the context of a world where war is unleashed with all its insane violence. It is set in real places, in Chiantishire, Tuscany in a historical context that is also real, that of July 1944.
But it is much more than that, and it is above all an intimate relationship between the player and Giulia and her way of seeing the world.

With Martha is Dead our main aim is to convey feelings, emotions, so my advice is to try to live the game by favouring emotionality over rationality.
Not that you don't need to reason in order to understand all the details of the story, far from it!
But I think that at least the first time you play it you should let yourself be captured by the atmosphere, let yourself be dragged into Giulia's mind, more and more deeply.

Martha is Dead required more than 5 years of development, constantly driven by passion. 
Additions, improvements, changes have made the game much richer than what was originally thought... we never wanted to stop developing and telling Martha's world: the protagonist with her dystopian family, the raging war, the lies, betrayals, the presence of a past still present, religion, superstition.

But here we are, the game is going to be released!

We wanted to create something special to launch Martha is Dead.
The thing I cared about most was communicating the atmosphere you will breathe in Martha's universe.
On this idea the launch trailer was born.
Julia tells about a nightmare that blurs into reality. A nightmare that is not present in the game, but that, like all the contents outside the game, serves to deepen Martha’s universe.
The whole thing has been realised with Unreal Engine, in real time, as if it were a scene from the game.
A brief meeting with Giulia before entering her mind!

I will never thank enough all those who have been following us since The Town of Light, but also all those who will trust us and immerse themselves in the experience offered by Martha is Dead.
A special thanks to the players who are looking for the connections between Martha is Dead and The Town of Light. It's amazing and rewarding to see how you can uncover even the most hidden details, the ones we thought no one would ever notice!"

--------------------------------------------------------

Couldn't have put it better ourselves to be honest! so we'll keep it short and sweet, we hope you enjoy your time in Tuscany, there is a LOT of extra things to be excited about today - some of which you might have missed - so for patch notes, schedules and competitions, make sure you visit out launch blog : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/515960/view/3115932326046587597]Martha Launch Blog 
[/url]

We're off to grab a little rest and start grabbing your feedback - until next time, hit the socials below, and we'll see you in Tuscany!

notes.title: MARTHA IS DEAD IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome To Tuscany[/h1]

The time has finally arrived! 
Martha Is Dead is now... err. LIVE on Steam!

You can catch our chilling launch trailer right here 

[previewyoutube=2KN1qelGiTk;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven't already - get yourself over to the store page now where our launch stream is well underway, featuring some behind the scenes footage, competitions, and streams of the game from content creators around the world!

On top of the launch we've got a couple of extra things to update you on, so let's get stuck into them so you can get playing!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

Yes there is a day one patch! It fixes lots of small bugs and gives everything a layer of polish and a performance boost, for those that like knowing what's included - here's the list :

- Game content brought up to date, encompassing hundreds of gameplay fixes.
- Hundreds of console specific fixes and polish items.
- Lighting rebuilt to rectify obvious issues.
- Stability drastically improved.
- Old gen console graphics enhanced, textures are now clearer.
- Skip optional functionality added to sensitive scenes
- Performance improved for all platforms 

Should there be any bugs or issues encountered during play - don't panic!
Get yourself over to our Discord and ask for assistance in the support channel - or hit us up on our Twitter DM's with your issue and we'll investigate it ASAP

You can find our Discord here : [url=https://discord.gg/wiredp]Wired Discord[/url]
And our Twitter account here : [url=https://twitter.com/WiredP]Wired Twitter[/url]

We'll be collecting all of peoples known issues and bugs shortly after launch and will provide an FAQ / Known issues bug collection post in the forums here once we can see what isn't a one off occurrence - so help us help you with that feedback!

[h2]Competitions [/h2]

It wouldn't be a Wired launch without a healthy dose of competition goodness to go with it!

We'll have multiple social competitions dropping on our socials over the next few days, focusing on some nifty peripherals and gaming gear, so be sure to keep your eyes on all our socials listed at the bottom of this post!

However we have three 'big' competitions coming off the back of the launch - where you can win a steamdeck, a 3080 video card, or for the superfan, a vinyl player, rare test pressing of the OST and some hand made marionette dolls! 

(There is also some super scret code hidden in our launch stream loop that will give you lots of bonus entries for the Steam Deck comp)

You can find the links to these below :

Win a Steam Deck : [url=https://gleam.io/uV4fk/steam-deck-giveaway]Competition[/url]
Win an Nvidia 3080 : [url=https://gleam.io/9nJBT/founders-edition-nvidia-rtx-3080-graphics-card]Competition [/url]
Win a Vinyl Player, Test Pressing and Marionettes : [url=https://gleam.io/BCHpt/win-a-vinyl-player-test-press-and-hand-made-marionette-puppets]Competition [/url]

Good luck! 

[h2]Thank you [/h2]

And finally, thank you - every single one of you - from the OG Town Of Light fans, to those that have joined over the course of Martha development, to those that played the demo and gave feedback and everyone in between!

This project is a special one, Luca and the team at LKA really poured their heart and soul into the game, and we feel privileged to be able to help them get their story and world out for you all to play!

There will be a special edition of Martha Uncovered later today with some words from the team themselves at the finishing line, so keep an eye out for that - but in the meantime, if you have played the game, PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW! An honest one! It helps so much more than you'll know, and is the absolute best way to support developers of games you've enjoyed!

Now, stop reading this and go get playing! Take lots of screenshots and photos and share them with us... they might have use in a little while ;)

We're here! 
After six years of development and delays though covid, we're finally here! 

Martha Is Dead will be going live in about 3 hours, and we thought we'd give you a quick run down of what to expect across the course of the day!

[h3] At about 13:30 GMT / 08:30 - ET / 05:30- PT / 15:30 CEST - Our launch celebration live stream will begin on the Martha Is Dead steam page! [/h3]

Q) What's in the stream?

A) Lots! There'll be a little thank you prelude from one of our community staff as well as the reveal of our launch trailer and some bonus entries for our Steam Deck competition!

We've got localised gameplay from several regions from some of our content creator friends (keep an eye for the flags in the corner of the streams to click on the one that you'd like to watch!) 

And just in case folks have been missing out an episode or two of Martha Uncovered, where Luca and the team go through some behind the scenes development bits!

[h3] At 14:00 GMT / 09:00 - ET / 06:00 PT / 16:00 CEST - MARTHA IS DEAD WILL BE LIVE ON STEAM![/h3]

Q) Wait it's that time and it still doesn't say live?! What gives!?

A) Sometimes it takes a moment, refresh and try again!

[h3]At 16:00 GMT / 11:00 - ET / 08:00 PT / 18:00 CEST We'll be sharing a thank you from Luca and the team for all your support and a special launch episode of 'Martha Uncovered![/h3]

[h3]And at about 09:00am on Friday the 25th Martha Is Dead will be live on Steam for all our fans in China![/h3]

We promise you, every ounce of love and passion within LKA Games has gone into Martha Is Dead, and we can't WAIT for you all to find out what happened to Martha (No, she's not in need of being saved by Batman, Yes we've seen the thousands of memes sent out way! :) )

We do ask you try not to post spoilers, we'd love players to experience the game in full and we really look forward to reading your reviews! 

We're already working on a patch but if you do spot issues, drop it in the discussions or email us direct at support@wiredproductions.com. We'll be going live for a stream from 1:30pm where we'll be playing some of Martha, share details on our launch competitions (everything from Steam Decks to Razor gear! Keep an eye on our socials for more info!) From everyone at Wired and LKA - thank you.

notes.title: Martha Is Dead - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Last week at the Golden Joysticks awards we dropped a brand new teaser for Martha Is Dead, not only that, after two years... we have a release date and it's only weeks away! Launching February 24th, Martha Is Dead combines real-world locations, working in links to historical events during the latter stages of World War II, superstition, folklore, and deep psychological distress. Martha Is Dead has been a long journey for the team at LKA, but we’re now nearing the point where the whole world will get to play it and we cannot wait. It's an experience curated to be faithfully accurate to the era, from our authentic recreation of the Tuscan countryside through to the impact that WWII had on Italy.

notes.title: Black Label #02 Preorders Are Now Live!
notes.content:
[h2]What Is Black Label?[/h2]

The Black Label is a reflection of the way Wired Productions curates its games. It is a celebration of art, music and most importantly; the teams behind each release and their ethos and experiences. Limited to a maximum of 2,500 units, each is beautifully crafted and carefully selected to spotlight one of the many eclectic games Wired publish from developers we love

Release #02 of the Black Label includes:

[list]
[*] THE TOWN OF LIGHT PS4 enclosed in the limited Black Label variant inlay and sleeve.
[*] Stunning art prints hand-chosen by LKA developer founder Luca Dalcò.
[*] CD and Digital Download soundtrack by acclaimed artist and musician Aseptic Void.
[*] A Wired Razor authenticity card – individually numbered.
[*] Iconic razor cut Alu-dibond art print.
[*] Collectable trading cards from the Wired Productions collection.
[*] All housed in a bespoke high-end Black Label silver box wrapped in the Wired Razor Sleeve – a black finish with an embossed tattoo motif.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11453571/6998cab098b16ffabd7f0182abe50ac3a42cea6d.png[/img]

[h2]Wired and The Town Of Light :[/h2]

For Wired Productions, there has been no game that has had a bigger impact to the business greater than The Town of Light. It changed not only the type of game Wired signs, but really kick started a movement within the company that led to some of the team co-founding the now global video games mental health charity Safe In Our World. From the first time the publishing team played a demo of title, they were shocked, in awe and knew instantly that this was a game that needed to be played. This challenged the whole team to evaluate the Games Wired scouts, changing truly to finding indie games that deserved more players, who needed support to get their story told. Its deep routes in historic facts, its personal story and the way it truly made the player think, long after gameplay had finished, was like nothing the team had played. It’s journey to publishing saw the teams collaborate on video shoots, press tours of the very really building in Tuscany, Italy and a global campaign to raise player awareness around mental health. Close to 5 years later, Wired and LKA collaborated again with the release of Martha Is Dead, a title than continues the almost cinematic story telling the studio has now become famous for - which you can visit on Steam here to learn more about

https://store.steampowered.com/app/515960/Martha_Is_Dead/

Pre-orders are now live for The Town Of Light Black Label - [url=https://limitedrungames.com/collections/in-stock/products/wired-presents-black-label-02-town-of-light-switch]available from our friends at limited run games in the US[/url] - or [url=https://shop.wiredproductions.com/collections/the-black-label/products/black-label-02-the-town-of-light]direct from our store for the rest of the world [/url]

notes.title: Fifth anniversary and new languages available!
notes.content:
This is a great day for [b]The Town of Light[/b]. Five years ago the adventure started on Steam and even today, after 5 years, we continue to receive your reviews and emails, thank you!

In [b]The Town on of Light[/b] the story is paramount and being able to follow it in your own language helps to immerse yourself even more in Renée's mind.

For this reason, even though we are a small team, we have always tried to support as many languages as possible. We have decided to celebrate this anniversary by adding new languages:

[b]Simplified Chinese[/b] subtitles
[b]Traditional Chinese[/b] subtitles
[b]Japanese [/b]subtitles

[b]Japanese [/b]full voice-over

We hope to add more languages to the already long list of those supported ones in the future.

The game will be on sale till Monday, -85% off. 

Don't forget to support us by adding our new title [b]Martha is Dead[/b] to your wish list!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/515960/Martha_Is_Dead/

notes.title: The Town of Light heading to Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
Hey folks! As many of you know, the team is hard at work on our next title, Martha is Dead! But The Town of Light remains a very important title for us. This Friday sees the launch of Renèe's story on Nintendo Switch for $9.99, with 10% of proceeds being donated to video games mental health charity, [url=https://safeinourworld.org]Safe In Our World[/url] - you can learn more about the Nintendo release [url=https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/The-Town-of-Light-Deluxe-Edition-1711505.html]here[/url]. Packed with documentary footage about how we created the game, we hope this new edition will help continue to put a spotlight on what was, and is still, a very important subject for all of the team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11453571/30bbc1a1c10656abea42db0d8e23179a82255c04.jpg[/img]

The Town of Light has always been a labour of love, and we're so happy to be able to share the story on another platform, but of course, we're also very focused on our next story, and hope you'll continue with us there too!

Thank you for your support <3

notes.title: Get 20% Off and Support Mental Health Charity, Take This!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11453571/41367db5f57a403c6f48d6f6a9ad85c1a37a5cdf.jpg[/img]

We are pleased to announce the first piece of activity in our year-long campaign to raise money for Mental Health charities.

Kicking off Thursday 17th and running to September 6th, [b]25%[/b] of profits from all sales of [b]The Town of Light[/b] on steam will be placed into a new fund to support mental health charities, including Take This, Inc! What's more, we're offering you [b]20%[/b] savings during this period!

This promotion marks the beginning of a year-long campaign to help raise awareness and bring ongoing attention to the importance of mental health. The proceeds from the campaign will help fund vital services offered by [b]Take This, Inc[/b], which include providing mental health education and referral resources, as well as the popular ‘AFK Rooms’ - staffed mental wellness spaces at some of the world’s most prominent video games events.

It's our duty is to stand together and continue the conversation around mental health, not only to ensure that we dispel the stigma, but also to ensure that those who feel alone know that they are not, and are given the help they often desperately need. This promotion, alongside our extended campaign for awareness, forms only a small part of a much greater picture, but we hope they will touch many lives.

[b]For more information, or to find links to gain resources, please visit the [url=http://wiredproductions.com/charity] Wired Charity Hub [/url] [/b]

notes.title: The Town of Light Enhanced update is now available for everyone
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to be able to share that to coincided with today’s console release of The Town of Light published by Wired Productions, we’ve just activated an update to bring all the new content to steam players, for FREE! This is a thank you for all your support on our project, The update brings new story elements, graphical improvements, new VO and an amazing score!
 
We’ve also just released a collector’s edition, which can be viewed here: 
[url=https://shop.wiredproductions.com/collections/the-town-of-light]Wired Productions Shop[/url]
 
Thank you for all your support so far!

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now find the parts of the Renée’s Diary inside the game
[*]Renée’s Diary is now accessible in the Synopsis menu
[*]2 new achievements related to Renée’s Diary
[*]New hallucination experience
[*]New documents added
[*]New historical photos added
[*]Controller vibration added
[*]Reworked and optimized vegetation with autumn look
[*]Reworked elevator and several assets
[*]Reworked textures
[*]Voiceover extended
[*]Improved performance
[*]Lower loading time with percentage
[*]New UI system
[*]New Title screen menu
[*]New animated credits screen 
[*]Added the song “Soley - I Will Find you”
[*]The menu will show which story path you are going down, based on the choices you have made so far.
[*]Added more drawings triggerable by objects inside the asylum
[*]Live action trailer accessible from the main menu (at the end of the game)
[*]Quit alert added
[*]Alienware plugin added
[*]NVIDIA Ansel supported
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]

notes.title: Asylum horror The Town of Light being fancied up
notes.content: The abandoned ayslum of psychological explore-o-horror The Town of Light [official site] is being spruced up a bit. Developers LKA have been making The Town of Light prettier and a bit bigger for its upcoming console release, see, and say those changes will come back to PC. Our Adam quite liked The Town of Light when it hit last year, especially having visited the real-world ruined asylym it’s set in, so good, good news for folks with a similar horrorhead to that lad. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Patch 1.51: New English localization
notes.content:
Hi all, due to the high number of feedbacks, we decided to rework the English translation and the voice acting.

Our Art director, Luca Dalcò, went to Rome in “Local Transit”, a professional recording studio, to supervise the actress performance, with the kind collaboration of Angela Paoletti, managing director for Local Transit (Everybody’s gone to the rapture, DC Universe, Everquest II).

We feel the voice acting is very important for our game in order to create the right mood. The Town of Light deserves a great voice acting, now we are very satisfied with the result.

We can’t wait to hear your new feedbacks.

[h1]Other improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Audio Polishes
[*]The maze has been reworked with new assets
[*]Performance optimization
[*]Improved gamepad controls
[/list]
